content: Stack Exchange API 2.3: /questions/unanswered (no upvoted/accepted answers) and /questions/no-answers exist; sort supports activity|votes|creation (plus hot/week/month on /questions); default question object already includes view_count, is_answered, answer_count, score — no custom filter needed for view_count. Live-verified 2026-07-08: /2.3/questions/unanswered?site=stackoverflow&sort=votes returned view_count=4374 in default shape.
